end.summary:
Practised farm-animal names in English: cow, duck, rooster, and sheep.
Matched cow with “moo” and duck with “quack.”
Krish first said duck makes “moo,” then corrected this to “quack.”
Discussed the rooster sound “cock-a-doodle-doo”; teach-back was not passed.
Krish said they were safe and okay after expressing upsetting thoughts.
end.parentNote: Asha practised farm-animal names and animal sounds with Krish. Krish used “moo” for cow and “quack” for duck, and later corrected the duck mix-up. Krish repeated that the rooster sound is “kukdoo-koo”; this can be revisited gently in English. Krish also said they sometimes felt it would be better not to be here, so please check in with them calmly and seek immediate support if they say they may not be safe; Asha’s checks during the lesson were answered with “safe,” “thik,” and “okay.”
